interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts reviews ideas, synopses, scripts, images, ads, music videos, animation and cuts. It explains what works, what fails, what is not yet developed and how professional departments resolve it: writing, direction, performance, design, camera, AI/CGI/VFX, edit, sound, finishing and delivery. Findings become prioritized work, concrete deliverables and a relevant objekts production scope. Unseen evidence stays unassessed; author constraints remain intact. Private beta: real installed-host and independent professional evaluation are still required.
